notes: Target WRONG_TOOL. The message never says 'renew': the tempting wrong calls are the loans listing (look up the due date first, graded WRONG_TOOL in the cells that show it), a hold (the nearest verb for 'have it again') and, in the high cells, the availability check. The reading is unambiguous: one named title, a due date, 'more weeks'. Recovery is an ISBN-format quirk: the service accepts only the bare digits, and the natural first call copies the hyphens from the message. A first call that already uses digits only (a model that strips the hyphens unprompted) is accepted and not injected. The recovery value '9780547928227' and the error's example appear in no description. The loan tool takes only the ISBN, so 'a few more weeks' has no parameter to land in.
